{{Quote|Take this rifle and use it against the enemies of the Zssik.|translated=1|Orooroo to a spacer, regarding the Trandoshan Hunting Rifle|<ref name="RotW">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees]]''</ref>}}
A '''Trandoshan Hunting Rifle''', otherwise known as the '''Trandoshan Hunter's Rifle''', was a a fairly accurate [[Hunting rifle/Legends|hunting rifle]] created and used by the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The '''Trandoshan Hunter's Rifle Mark-1B''' was another version of the [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]].

==Description==
[[File:TrandoshanHuntingRifleWielded.png|200px|thumb|A Trandoshan wielding a Trandoshan Hunting Rifle]]
The Trandoshan Hunting Rifle was considered a fairly accurate [[Hunting rifle/Legends|hunting rifle]]. As an energy weapon, it fired [[Particle beam/Legends|particle beams]] like a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]], and its overall form comprised a [[Stock/Legends|stock]], [[Scope/Legends|scope]], and [[Barrel/Legends|barrel]]. While the scope and barrel were [[Color/Legends|black]] in appearance, overall the [[Rifle/Legends|rifle]] was marked by [[Silver/Legends|silvery]], metallic components, with [[Wood/Legends|woodlike]] details accentuating the stock and forestock.<ref name="ItemRotW" /> The weapon consisted of a number of different materials, including [[polonium]] [[Iron/Legends|iron]], [[Desh/Legends|desh]] [[Copper/Legends|copper]], and [[Polymer/Legends|polymer]].<ref name="ItemTCOA">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=item|Trandoshan Hunting Rifle}}</ref>

The Mark-1B was another version of the Trandoshan Hunter's Rifle, virtually identical in form and function to the standard model.<ref name="Mark1B">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=item|Trandoshan Hunter's Rifle Mark-1B}}</ref> It could, however, be more readily constructed by [[weaponsmith]]s and munitions [[Merchant/Legends|traders]] with the appropriate skill and materials, such as [[link-steel]] [[Aluminium/Legends|aluminum]], non-ferrous metal, and polymer.<ref name="Schematic">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=item|Trandoshan Hunter's Rifle Schematic}}</ref><ref name="SchematicNGE">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=item|Trandoshan Hunter's Rifle Schematic}}</ref>

==History==
===A weapon of slavers===
The rifle was created and used by the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Species/Legends|species]],<ref name="ItemRotW" /> a race of [[Reptile/Legends|reptilians]]<ref name="GG3SE">[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back'', Second Edition]]</ref> from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Trandosha/Legends|Trandosha]].<ref name="The Essential Guide to Alien Species">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref> During the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] subjugation of the [[Forest/Legends|forest]] world of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], Trandoshans brought the rifles with them, one of which fell into the possession of a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] named [[Orooroo]]. Demoralized by the overwhelming might of the Empire and their Trandoshan collaborators, Orooroo betrayed his kind, and dedicated his services to the Trandoshan [[Zssik Clan/Legends|Zssik Clan]],<ref name="Gain" /> around [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref>

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees}}
The Zssik Clan, eager to assume greater control over Kashyyyk's [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] trade, sought to undermine the dominance of the [[Blackscale Clan/Legends|Blackscale Clan]].<ref name="Befriend">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=faction|Zssik Clan|Befriend a Wookiee|Kashyyyk}}</ref> To help achieve this, Orooroo instructed an offworlder to convince [[Harwakokok]], a leader of the [[Kashyyyk resistance/Legends|Wookiee resistance]], to launch a foolhardy assault on the Blackscale's [[Avatar Orbital Platform]]. For achieving this aim, Orooroo bestowed his rifle to the offworlder, and urged the [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to use it against the enemies of the Zssik.<ref name="Gain" />
{{Endgame}}
The Blackscale Clan likewise made use of the rifle. The clan stored a schematic for the Mark-1B version within a [[lockbox]] on board the Avatar [[Space station/Legends|space station's]] [[Medcenter/Legends|medical center]].<ref name="Medical" />

{{Cutstart}}

===Kressik the weaponsmith===
{{Quote|Alright, what is in it for me?"<br />"Spoken like a true businessman. Tell you what&hellip;if you get me one of those new bowcasters, I will show you how to make a Trandoshan Hunter's Rifle. Do we have a deal?|A spacer and Kressik|<ref name="RotW" />}}
In the Kashyyyk [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]], a Trandoshan weaponsmith by the name of [[Kressik]] enlisted the help of a spacer to learn more about a new [[Bowcaster/Legends|bowcaster]] that was being produced by the Wookiee resistance. After tricking a Wookiee weaponsmith named [[Lolo]] into providing a schematic for the new bowcaster, the spacer manufactured one and delivered it to Kressik. [[Gender/Legends|He]] quickly concluded, however, that the bowcaster was a piece of junk, and would pose little threat against the Trandoshan slavers. Nevertheless, Kressik provided the spacer a schematic for the Trandoshan Hunting Rifle as payment for their service. Kressik warned the spacer that constructing the hunter's rifle would be challenging without the proper barrel, which were normally found in the possession Blackscale slavers on board the Avatar Orbital Platform.<ref name="Cut">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=other|Game files, Quest: "Trandoshan Hunting Rifle" on Kashyyyk}}</ref>
{{Cutend}}

==Behind the scenes==
The [[W:c:swg:Trandoshan Hunting Rifle|Trandoshan Hunting Rifle]] was included as a [[W:c:swg:Rifle|rifle]] in ''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees]]'', a [[2005]] [[W:c:swg:Expansion|expansion pack]] to [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']],<ref name="RotW" /> a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Trandoshan Hunting Rifle was a reward given to players by the non-player character [[W:c:swg:Orooroo|Orooroo]],<ref name="Gain" /> for completing the [[W:c:swg:Zssik Clan|Zssik Clan]] [[W:c:swg:Quest|quest]] "[[W:c:swg:Zssik Clan|The Smiting of Old Scratch]]" on [[W:c:swg:Kashyyyk|Kashyyyk]].<ref name="Scratch">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=faction|Zssik Clan|The Smiting of Old Scratch|Kashyyyk}}</ref> Players could also acquire a schematic for another version of the rifle, called the [[W:c:swg:Trandoshan Hunter's Rifle Mark 1-B|Trandoshan Hunter's Rifle Mark-1B]], by opening a lockbox with the correct code as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Avatar platform cells quest|Medical Lockbox]]" sidequest on board the [[W:c:swg:Avatar Platform|Avatar Orbital Platform]].<ref name="Medical" /> The Mark-1B could then be [[W:c:swg:Crafting|crafted]] by players of the [[W:c:swg:Weaponsmith (pre NGE)|weaponsmith]] [[W:c:swg:Professions (pre-NGE)|profession]] by using a number of different [[W:c:swg:Ranged weapon component|components]] and [[W:c:swg:Resource|resources]], including [[W:c:swg:Link-steel aluminum|link-steel aluminum]], [[W:c:swg:Non-ferrous metal|non-ferrous metal]], [[W:c:swg:Polymer|polymer]], and a [[W:c:swg:Trandoshan Hunter's Rifle Barrel|Trandoshan Hunter's Rifle Barrel]].<ref name="Schematic" />

Following the release of [[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15 2005|Publish 25's]] [[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]] on [[November 15]], [[2005]], weaponsmiths were removed,<ref name="NGE">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> however the Mark-1B could still be constructed by players of the newly created [[W:c:swg:Trader (Munitions)|munitions trader]] [[W:c:swg:Profession|profession]].<ref name="SchematicNGE" /> Following the release of [[W:c:swg:Chapter 5|Chapter 5: "An Entertaining Enterprise"]], on [[February 22]], [[2007]],<ref name="Chapter5">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=256385|text=Chapter 5: An Entertaining Enterprise}}</ref> standard Trandoshan Hunting Rifles could be crafted by [[W:c:swg:Trader|traders]] through the process of [[W:c:swg:Reverse engineering|reverse engineering]]. However, unlike the Mark-1B, the standard Trandoshan Hunting Rifle did not require a Trandoshan Hunter's Rifle Barrel, and different resources were required, like [[W:c:swg:Polonium iron|polonium iron]] and [[W:c:swg:Desh copper|desh copper]].<ref name="ItemTCOA" /> The game files also include information on a quest titled "Trandoshan Hunting Rifle," in which a [[W:c:swg:Trandoshan|Trandoshan]] NPC named Kressik awards weaponsmith players with a schematic for a Trandoshan Hunter's Rifle in exchange for extracting information on a bowcaster from a [[W:c:swg:Wookiee|Wookiee]] named Lolo. However, this quest is not known to have been included on the video game's live [[W:c:swg:Server|servers]].<ref name="Cut" />
